description: This file contains Odoo (OpenERP) module code defining models and views related to account receivables, aged receivables, and invoice reports, including SQL view creation and data processing methods.

classes.name: report_account_receivable
classes.description: Model representing receivable accounts with a SQL view for weekly summaries.

classes.name: temp_range
classes.description: Temporary model used for dashboard range calculations.

classes.name: report_aged_receivable
classes.description: Model for aged receivable reports with dynamic view creation based on fiscal year ranges.

classes.name: report_invoice_created
classes.description: Model for recent invoice creation reports with SQL view.

methods.name: _code_get
methods.description: Retrieves account type codes and names for selection field.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates or replaces SQL views for report models, and initializes data for aged receivable ranges.

methods.name: fields_view_get
methods.description: Ensures init is called once to set up the view.

methods.name: _calc_bal
methods.description: Calculates the balance for aged receivable periods based on date ranges.
